name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
about: PNB Housing Finance offers retail customers housing and non-housing loans, including individual home loans, loan against property, non-resident property loan, among others. It is promoted by Punjab National Bank. [1]
keyPoints: Service Offerings:[1] The company provides loans to purchase, construct, repair, and upgrade houses. It also provides loans for commercial space, loans against property, and loans for purchasing residential plots.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 19.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.24% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.2% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost

announcements.text: Corrigendum - Capital Adequacy Ratio - Q2FY27 Disclosures 19 Nov - Corrigendum revises Q2FY27 CRAR to 27.33% from 27.03%.

Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 18 Nov - PNB Housing Finance senior executive Anshul Dalela resigns, effective November 30, 2026; COO Jatul Anand takes charge temporarily.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 18 Nov - PNB Housing Finance to attend DAM Capital’s NBFC Conference 2026 on November 25, 2026 in Mumbai.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 17 Nov - PNB Housing Finance Limited has informed regarding Allotment of 1,69,961 Equity shares
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment 13 Nov - Allotted 75,000 NCDs worth ₹750 crore at 8.62%, maturing January 7, 2030.
